ingredientSections.heading: Salad
items: ½ Cup Avocado Ranch Dressing (see below)
12 Pieces Confit Pork Belly, about 30g each (see below)

ingredientSections.heading: Confit Pork Belly
items: 450g Smoked Pork Belly or Smoked Slab Bacon

methodSections.heading: Avocado Ranch Dressing
steps: Place dressing ingredients in a blender and blend until smooth.

methodSections.heading: Breaded Soft Poached Eggs
steps: Bring a saucepan of water to a gentle simmer and add a small splash of vinegar or lemon juice. Create a slow whirlpool in the water by stirring.
Break an egg into a ramekin or cup and then pour gently, whites first, into the centre of the whirlpool.
Cook for three minutes or until soft but approaching medium. Remove from water with a slotted spoon and place straight into an ice bath. Repeat with three of the remaining eggs.
Beat the final two eggs into an egg wash in a bowl. Add the flour and the breadcrumbs to two other bowls.
Roll each poached egg in the flour, then the egg wash and finally in the breadcrumbs.
Heat the oil in a small saucepan until hot and fry the breaded eggs for about one minute or until just crispy golden brown.

methodSections.heading: Confit Pork Belly
steps: Preheat the oven to 150°C (300°F). Place the pork in a small baking dish and three quarter cover with vegetable oil.
Place in the oven for about 3 hours. Remove and allow the pork to cool in the oil for at least an hour. Drain the oil and transfer the pork to the fridge.
When the pork belly has cooled in the fridge for a few hours cut it into roughly one centimetre slices.
Just before serving the salad sear the pork belly in a hot fry pan until crispy golden brown, about two minutes per side.

methodSections.heading: Pickled Peaches
steps: Remove the stones, cut the peaches into thin wedges and place in a bowl.
In a small saucepan, bring the vinegar to a simmer with the cloves, bay leaves and salt.
Pour over the peaches and let sit for at least a few hours.

methodSections.heading: Assembly
steps: Carefully pull the leaves from the lettuce keeping them in large pieces.
Cut the tomatoes into wedges. In a large mixing bowl dress the lettuce, add the green onions and mix through.
Arrange the dressed lettuce into four bowls and top each salad with three pieces of seared pork belly, a crisp egg and some peaches, tomatoes, Stilton and croutons. Serve immediately.
